    if n['color'] == 'b':
        player = n
        break

    print(f"Player position: {pc}")

    print(f"\nPlayer adjacencies:")
    for adj in seg['adjacency_list']:
        if adj[0] == player['id'] or adj[1] == player['id']:
            other_id = adj[1] if adj[0] == player['id'] else adj[0]
            other = next(x for x in seg['nodes'] if x['id'] == other_id)
            o_center = (sum(p[0] for p in other['boundary'])//len(other['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in other['boundary'])//len(other['boundary']))
            dr = o_center[0] - pc[0]
            dc = o_center[1] - pc[1]
            direction = ''
            if dr < 0: direction = 'UP'
            elif dr > 0: direction = 'DOWN'
            elif dc < 0: direction = 'LEFT'
            elif dc > 0: direction = 'RIGHT'
            print(f"  {other['color']} at {o_center}, direction={direction}, offset=({dr}, {dc})")

# Continue moving RIGHT
result = action(['RIGHT'], intent='re-explore')
print(f"\nAfter RIGHT: player at ", end='')

player2 = None
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        player2 = n
        break
if player2:
    pc2 = (sum(p[0] for p in player2['boundary'])//len(player2['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in player2['boundary'])//len(player2['boundary']))
    print(f"{pc2}")
else:
    print("dead")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
